definitions.explanation: The process of raising the temperature of something by applying heat.

examples.japanese: {電子|でんし}レンジで2{分|ふん}{加熱|かねつ}してください。
examples.english: Please heat it in the microwave for 2 minutes.

examples.japanese: {加熱|かねつ}{調理|ちょうり}が{必要|ひつよう}な{食品|しょくひん}です。
examples.english: This is a food product that requires cooking with heat.

examples.japanese: {加熱|かねつ}{式|しき}タバコの{普及|ふきゅう}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Heat-not-burn tobacco products are becoming widespread.
examples.notes: [Note: 加熱式タバコ = heated tobacco products]

notes:
COOKING:
・{加熱|かねつ}する (to heat)
・{加熱|かねつ}{調理|ちょうり} (cooking with heat)
・{加熱|かねつ}{殺菌|さっきん} (heat sterilization)
・{要|よう}{加熱|かねつ} (requires heating)

FOOD SAFETY:
・{十分|じゅうぶん}に{加熱|かねつ}する (to heat thoroughly)
・{加熱|かねつ}{不足|ふそく} (insufficient heating)

TECHNICAL:
・{加熱|かねつ}{式|しき}タバコ (heated tobacco product)
・{加熱|かねつ}{装置|そうち} (heating device)

ANTONYM:
・{冷却|れいきゃく} (cooling)

SIMILAR:
・{温|あたた}める (to warm up - general)
・{熱|ねっ}する (to heat - technical)
